title.pinyin: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ
title.english: Let me think about it and I'll tell you later

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我们下午去看电影,好吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?
dialogue.english: Let's go see a movie this afternoon, shall we?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 今天下午我没有时间,明天下午再去吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān xiàwǔ zài qù ba.
dialogue.english: I'm not free this afternoon. Let's go tomorrow afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.english: Which movie would you like to see?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.
dialogue.english: Let me think about it and I'll tell you later.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 外边天气很好,我们出去运动运动吧!
dialogue.pinyin: Wàibian tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqu yùndòng yùndòng ba!
dialogue.english: It's a nice day outside. Let's go out to exercise.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 你等等我,好吗?王老师让我给大卫打个电话。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ děngdeng wǒ, hǎo ma? Wáng lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi Dàwèi dǎ ge diànhuà.
dialogue.english: Please wait for me a minute, will you? Professor Wang asked me to call David.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 回来再打吧。找大卫有什么事情吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Huílai zài dǎ ba. Zhǎo Dàwèi yǒu shénme shìqing ma?
dialogue.english: Call him after we come back. What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 听说大卫病了,我想找时间去看看他。
dialogue.pinyin: Tīngshuō Dàwèi bìng le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shíjiān qù kànkan tā.
dialogue.english: I heard David is sick. I want to find time to go visit him.

title.english: At the front desk of a hotel

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 服务员,我房间的门打不开了。
dialogue.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒ fángjiān de mén dǎ bu kāi le.
dialogue.english: Excuse me, I can't open my door.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ jiào rén qù kànkan.
dialogue.english: OK. I'll send someone to have a look.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你看看这几件衣服怎么样。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kànkan zhè jǐ jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.
dialogue.english: What do you think of these dresses?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这件白的有点儿长,那件黑的有点儿贵。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè jiàn bái de yǒudiǎnr cháng, nà jiàn hēi de yǒudiǎnr guì.
dialogue.english: This white one is a bit too long. That black one is a bit expensive.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 这件红的呢?这是今天新来的。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè jiàn hóng de ne? Zhè shì jīntiān xīn lái de.
dialogue.english: What about this red one? This one has just got here today.

explanation.hanzi: 表示一个动作或一种状态重复或继续,也可用来表示一个动作将要在某一情况下出现。
explanation.english: Indicates the repetition or continuation of an action or state. It can also indicate that an action will happen under a certain condition.

explanation.hanzi: 兼语句的谓语是由两个动词短语组成,前一个动词的宾语是第二个动词的主语。前一个动词常常是"请、让、叫"等词语。
explanation.english: A pivotal sentence's predicate has two verbal phrases — the object of the first verb is the subject of the second. The first verb is often a causative like 请 (invite), 让 (let), or 叫 (ask/tell).

explanation.hanzi: 动词的重叠形式用来表达短时间、少量、轻微、尝试的意思,语气比较轻松、随便,多用于口语中。
explanation.english: A reduplicated verb indicates a short time, small amount, slight degree, or attempt — a relaxed, casual tone. Common in spoken Chinese. Monosyllabic verbs use AA or A一A; disyllabic verbs use ABAB.
